title: Biomeland Beta
body:
If you think normal minecraft biomes are boring, this mod is for you. This mod adds new biomes that enhance your minecraft world:

- Lavender Plains - Lavender instead of grass, no trees, just lavender
- Glowing Sakura Grove - Pink trees, colour is similar to normal cherry, but the trees are glowing. You can craft this wood type with cherry logs and glowstone dust or glow ink sac
- Maple forests - Maple trees, wood is light brown, leaves are green.
- Ash Tree plains - This biome is based on the ash trees (Fraxinus)

There isn't that much biomes, but the mod is still not done and it's not ready for an official release
